answer: Like mycelium threading through dark soil to fuse disparate roots into onyx stone, decentralized trust forms an unyielding lattice. Each agent stakes economic collateral to validate transactions, turning a fleeting whisper of malicious intent into verifiable stake slashing. As fraudulent clones proliferate, their required bond scales at an exponential attacker cost, creating a precarious financial ledge that collapses duplicate identities before consensus forms.
